## Compatibility and safety

- [ ] Regression coverage fails without this change and passes with it, or the PR explains why no
      executable test applies.
- [ ] Generated files were updated through repository scripts rather than edited manually.
- [ ] The change does not narrow supported TypeSpec, TypeScript, Node.js, Bun, or adapter versions
      without updating the compatibility policy and CI matrix.
- [ ] The PR contains no credentials, private URLs, customer data, personal paths, or environment
      dumps.
- [ ] The PR does not create a tag, publish a package, or enable release automation.
